task: PRODUCT.md; JS-183, JS-198; supersedes D-092's one-product reading; restores D-085's issue routing
brief: brief-native-2026-11-27.md; the owner's later statements; po/native-plan.md
entry: Two separate products, one product owner each: "let's have one product owner for each because these are going to be two separate products launched independently." jellyscale's product owner plans jellyscale only; Octave keeps its own PRODUCT.md, product owner, plan and releases. The contract in jellyscale is the source of truth for what the server offers: each capability is published with example answers before the server serves it, a server is published for every merge, and every contract change reaches Octave as a from:jellyscale issue saying what changed and what each platform must do. Octave's requests come to jellyscale as from:fluster issues labelled by platform, triaged by jellyscale's product owner, as before. What jellyscale's own milestones need from Octave is stated as cross-project needs (the asks), never as tasks jellyscale controls.
